# Solana Health

> Solana Health is an allied health clinic at Shop 1, 448 Bunnerong Road, Matraville NSW 2036, in Sydney's south-eastern suburbs. It offers chiropractic care, physiotherapy and dry needling. Open Monday to Saturday, 8am to 8pm. Phone 0433 363 460. Email reception@solanahealth.com.au. Online bookings via Cliniko. HICAPS on-site claiming and Medicare Chronic Condition Management Plan (EPC) referrals accepted.

## Key facts
- Principal chiropractor: Dr Angelo Marketos (Chiropractor), practising since 2011, AHPRA registration CHI0001597312, member of Chiropractic Australia. Bachelor of Chiropractic Science and Master of Chiropractic.
- Physiotherapist: Jessica Whitling, BSc (Hons) Physiotherapy, AHPRA registration PHY0002805997, member of the Australian Physiotherapy Association. Particular interest in sports rehabilitation and lower limb injuries.
- Services available now: chiropractic (spinal adjustments, mobilisation, soft tissue therapy, exercise advice), physiotherapy and dry needling.
- Planned for a later stage: recovery services (infrared sauna, red light therapy).
- Conditions commonly seen: lower back pain, neck pain, headaches, sciatica, postural strain, shoulder injuries, sports injuries, knee and ankle sprains, WorkCover and CTP injuries.
- Areas served: Matraville, Maroubra, Malabar, Chifley, Little Bay, Phillip Bay, La Perouse, Eastgardens, Pagewood, Hillsdale, Botany and the wider Randwick and Bayside council areas.
- No referral needed for chiropractic. GP referral needed only to claim under a Medicare care plan.
- Parking on Bunnerong Road and side streets. Bus routes 390X, 391 and 393 stop nearby. Ground-floor, step-free entry.
- Operating entity: ANJM Pty Ltd trading as Solana Health.
